scenes.title: Level 9: Barre chords
scenes.subtitle: Unlock the whole neck
lines: Barre chords open the whole neck — let's start with your first full F, then move the E and A shapes to play Bm, Bb and more.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll play full F and other barre chords anywhere on the neck.
You'll use the E and A shapes to move chords around, and you'll play the Rising Sun progression.
This opens up a world of songs and styles.
Today we'll explore six barre chords: F major, A major at the 5th fret, F minor, F sharp minor, B minor and B flat major.

scenes.heading: Songs you'll play
lines: This level features one song: The Rising Sun Progression, a traditional instrumental that will help you practice and master barre chords.
Let's start with 'The barre' — your first full F, and the key to unlocking the whole neck.
